cases.name: Tamara Wilson-Seidle
cases.about: She worked at a church in Asbury Park, NJ. Tamara was a German-born breast cancer survivor who was a cheerleader, the Neptune High School homecoming queen, and a devoted Catholic.
cases.narrative: He pursued her in a high-speed chase with their 7-year-old daughter in his car, rammed her and got out and shot her 12 times while she was in her vehicle.
